blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The August Twenty-One Movement (Atom) joined groups opposing US President Donald Trump’s upcoming visit for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Meetings. The organization said Trump should not be welcomed with a red carpet. “Rather than roll out a red carpet for a leader like Trump, we should roll him out of the Philippines as soon as he sets foot in our sacred land,” said Atom in a statement on Thursday. The group called it “ironic” that Marcos was preparing to welcome Trump, despite the US leader’s alleged rejection by his own people in the recent midterm elections. “His anti-democratic […]...
